notes: Personally read all 50 complete blinded source reports and explicitly reasoned all 600 targets before opening the root reader draft or flags. The complete independent preread was persisted, hash-frozen, and announced to the parent before draft access. Compared all 600 states and source evidence; preserved all 32 initial disagreements across 24 studies below. After source rereads, retained all draft states, with independent evidence and expanded adjudication notes. Five preread fracture negatives were withdrawn because marrow-signal scope did not assess fracture morphology. Incidental bone pathology and bone-contusion mentions did not manufacture fracture target mentions. Four cartilage disagreements were resolved from anatomy and unresolved cartilage threshold evidence. All uncertain/not-mentioned states remain masked. Literal intact-number dimension debris at indices 10 and 20 is preserved as source corruption, never parsed as a measurement. Original preread and draft remain unchanged. Scripts only assembled explicit personal decisions and validated exact quotations, schema, hashes, UID membership and counts. No official gold, legacy annotations or automatic label inference used. Report-derived weak extraction is not an image diagnostic reread.
